name: DocXtractor
observations: Full-stack document data extraction platform at docxtractor.sk-salman.com
Users define Extractors (JSON schema + system prompt), upload files/URLs, trigger Runs that parse documents and extract structured JSON using AI via FreeLLM (Groq, Gemini, Mistral, Cerebras)
Tech stack: NestJS 11 backend, React 19 + TanStack Start frontend, Python workers (parser-service, extraction-service)
Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis (BullMQ), MinIO, FreeLLM
Docker Compose for local dev (7 services); separate prod/stage Compose files

name: NestJS Server
observations: Located in server/ directory, Port 3001
Node.js 22, TypeScript 5.7

Modules: AuthModule, UserModule, ExtractorsModule, RunsModule, FilesModule, QueueModule, LlmModule, MailModule, WorkflowsModule, DashboardModule, AdminModule, BackupModule, HealthModule, DemoModule, InstanceSettingsModule, InviteModule, NotificationModule
TypeORM with synchronize:false, migrationsRun:true (auto-applies migrations on boot)
Swagger at /api (basic auth: admin/admin), JSON spec at /api/swagger.json
All routes JWT-protected by default via global AccessTokenGuard; use @Public() for public endpoints
Global guards order: ThrottlerGuard > AccessTokenGuard > RolesGuard
ESLint flat config + Prettier, @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any is off
Commands: pnpm run start:dev, build, test, lint

name: React Client
observations: Located in client/ directory, Port 5174
React 19 + TanStack Start + TanStack Router v1 (file-based routing in src/routes/)
TanStack Query v5 via Orval-generated hooks into src/api/endpoints/, src/api/models/, src/api/schemas/
Run pnpm run gen:api after backend DTO/controller changes
Custom Axios instance in src/lib/axios.ts with JWT auto-attach and 401 token refresh with in-flight coalescing
Auth state: Zustand store in src/lib/auth-store.ts (cookie-persisted for SSR)
Real-time: socket.io-client subscribing to /runs namespace
UI: Custom RetroUI neobrutalist components in src/components/retroui/, plus Radix UI + Tailwind CSS v4
Modals: @ebay/nice-modal-react, Forms: react-hook-form + zod v4, Tables: TanStack Table v8, Code editor: Monaco
Linting: Biome v2 (tabs, double quotes for JS), pnpm run check
Path alias: @/* maps to ./src/*
Sentry monitoring in src/router.tsx

name: Parser Service
observations: Python worker in workers/parser-service/, Port 8001
Consumes uploaded-documents BullMQ queue
Uses Docling + RapidOCR to convert documents/URLs to Markdown
Also has MarkItDown and PyMuPDF engines
Fetches files from MinIO via boto3
Concurrency: PARSER_CONCURRENCY env var (default 4)
FastAPI app with lifespan manager that starts BullMQ consumer

name: Extraction Service
observations: Python worker in workers/extraction-service/, Port 8002
Consumes extraction-requests BullMQ queue
Uses OpenAI-compatible SDK pointed at FreeLLM gateway, or LangExtract library
Returns structured JSON
Concurrency: EXTRACTION_CONCURRENCY env var (default 3)
Needs .env with FREELLM_BASE_URL and LANGEXTRACT_API_KEY

name: BullMQ Queues
observations: 7 queues total: uploaded-documents, parsed-documents, extraction-requests, extraction-completed, workflow-executions, example-source-parse-requests, example-source-parse-completed
Queue names in server/src/shared/queue/queue-names.ts
Jobs default to 3 attempts with exponential backoff (5s base delay)
NestJS consumers (ParsedDocumentsConsumer, ExtractionCompletedConsumer) extend WorkerHost in queue-consumers.ts
Python consumers use bullmq Python package with Redis URL

name: Data Pipeline
observations: Upload > NestJS > uploaded-documents queue > Parser Service (Docling/PyMuPDF) > parsed-documents queue > NestJS RunsService > extraction-requests queue > Extraction Service (FreeLLM/LangExtract) > extraction-completed queue > NestJS > WebSocket to React Client
Two processing modes: UNIFIED (parse all, extract once) and PER_DOCUMENT (extract each doc individually with incremental WS updates)
Race conditions managed via per-run serialization locks, retryGeneration counters, Redis cancellation marks

name: Auth Flow
observations: JWT access token (short-lived) + refresh token (long-lived, cookie-persisted)
Auth providers: email/password (bcrypt) + Google OAuth (Passport strategies)
Global AccessTokenGuard on all routes; @Public() decorator to opt-out
Client-side Axios interceptor auto-attaches JWT, handles 401 refresh with coalescing, logs out on failure
InstanceSettings entity stores SMTP/OAuth config in DB (not env vars)

name: Extractor Entity
observations: Fields: schema (JSONB), systemPrompt, fewShotExamples (JSONB), extractionProvider enum (doclo|langextract|freellm), variants, parserEngine, consensus settings
ExtractorsModule calls FreeLLM to generate schemas from natural language

name: Run Entity
observations: Fields: status (pending>queued>parsing>extracting>done/failed/cancelled/review), sources (JSONB array with per-source parse status), extractionResult (JSONB), processingMode (unified|per_document), logs (JSONB)
Batch mode with FreeLLM uses Promise.allSettled for parallel extraction across documents
Orchestrated by RunsService (1600+ lines)

name: File Entity
observations: Fields: storageKey, bucket, status enum, metadata (JSONB), userId-scoped isolation
Stored in MinIO via @aws-sdk/client-s3, managed by FilesModule + StorageService

name: User Entity
observations: UUID PK, email, passwordHash (bcrypt), googleId, role (user/admin), isEmailVerified, OTP fields

name: WebSocket Gateway
observations: Namespace: /runs via RunsGateway (Socket.IO)
Rooms: run:{runId} (per-run updates), runs:list (list-level)
Client events: joinRun, leaveRun, joinRunsList, leaveRunsList
Server events: run:updated, run:source:updated, run:log, runs:list:updated
Auth: JWT token on connection handshake; invalid tokens disconnected

name: Workflows Module
observations: Internal workflow automation engine
Triggers: Webhook-based (webhook-trigger.controller.ts)
Nodes: Actions, conditions, processors (plugable in workflows/nodes/)
Execution via workflow-executions BullMQ queue and WorkflowExecutionsConsumer

name: Infrastructure Ports
observations: React Client:5174, NestJS API:3001, PostgreSQL:5433, Redis:6380/6381, MinIO API:9005, MinIO Console:9006, Parser:8001, Extraction:8002, FreeLLM:3002

name: Dev Workflow
observations: New API endpoint: 1) Create service/controller/DTOs 2) Restart server 3) pnpm run gen:api in client/ 4) Use generated hooks
Entity change: generate TypeORM migration from server/, review, commit alongside entity
Server: pnpm run start:dev, build, test, lint | Client: pnpm run dev, build, gen:api, check, format
Docker: docker-compose up -d --build (dev)
After gen:api, Orval runs biome format --write on generated code

name: Database Migrations
observations: synchronize: OFF in all envs; migrationsRun: true auto-applies on boot
Migration command: DATABASE_URL=... npx ts-node ... typeorm/cli.js migration:generate -d ./src/database/data-source.ts ./src/migrations/<ShortName>
Dev DB must be reachable on localhost:5433
Fresh VPS deploy: schema built from migrations on container start

name: FreeLLM Gateway
observations: Port 3002, runs as Docker service alongside everything
OpenAI-compatible API gateway supporting Groq, Gemini, Mistral, Cerebras, and other providers
FREELLM_BASE_URL env var (default: http://freellm:3002/v1)
Used by both LlmModule (NestJS) and extraction-service (Python)
